newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RGA in Malaysian life reinsurer JV - paper.
newsitem.headline: RGA in Malaysian life reinsurer JV - paper.

text.p: U.S.-listed Reinsurance Group of America (RGA) has been named as the joint venture partner selected to set up Malaysia's first life reinsurance company, a report in Singapore's Straits Times on Saturday said.

The report quoted Ezamshah Ismail, president of the Life Insurance Association of Malaysia (LIAM), as saying the new company would be set up by March as a joint venture between the association's 18 member companies and RGA.
The report said RGA would hold a 30 percent stake in the 50 million ringgit (US$20.1 million) capitalised company, with the balance held by a consortium of LIAM members, called Unit Pertiwi Sdn Bhd.
The new company will be called Malaysian National Life Reinsurance Bhd and will help Malaysia retain about 20 million ringitt in insurance premiums over the next decade.
The company could also move into Asia's regional reinsurance markets to bring premium dollars into Malaysia, the report said.
